# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **More efficient rendering and interop**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves browser WebGPU packaging, Android texture rendering, and managed graphics and text-shaping performance. WebGPU browser applications can link against the packaged native archive without compiling its C++ support themselves. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while image copying and HarfBuzz text shaping avoid unnecessary managed and native allocations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **WebGPU support is packaged with browser native assets** — The WebGPU C++ support is now built into libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications no longer compile it during their final link and C projects avoid incompatible C++ compiler flags. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows the display clock** — Continuous Android GL texture rendering is paced by display refresh rather than buffer-swap throughput, reducing unnecessary paint callbacks while preserving explicit render requests and lifecycle behavior. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered managed streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Corrects stream retention so front-buffered managed streams can release data when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies avoid an intermediate allocation** — Managed pixel buffers that can be copied directly now avoid creating an intermediate SKData instance while preserving existing validation behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text shaping reduces temporary allocations** — HarfBuzz UTF-32 buffer input and feature-string formatting reuse managed storage where possible, reducing allocation overhead without changing encoded text or feature decoding. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
